transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to sort out the placement for 'Glass Harbor' before the catalog goes to publication. As things stand, the draft lists it at 94 minutes with premiere status still unconfirmed. I'd like to hear from submissions and technical screening staff on whether there are any status or master-file issues we should be aware of before I make the final programming decision.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a premiere status issue. I checked the national festival database yesterday and confirmed that 'Glass Harbor' already had a public screening at the Coastline Film Week in this country. I recorded the result in my local review notes, but the database export feeding your catalog review hasn't refreshed yet, which is why the premiere status is still marked for confirmation in the draft.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I completed ingest quality control this morning and confirmed that the filmmaker's approved festival cut is an 88-minute DCP, not the 94 minutes listed in the catalog draft. The QC report is waiting in the technical queue and hasn't been attached to the programming record yet.
transcript.speaker: A3
